rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating on Amber (zone 406 -> about 360); this block's trees stand on grass round its buildings and on an open lawn
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's sixteen builder trees go (a grid of corals, jacarandas, magnolias and palms 1.4-5 m from the houses, others on the east lawn); four come back on their own spots with room round them: two on the open lawn, two by the west houses.

trees.why: the open lawn on the east side, 15 m from the walls, by the bird of paradise: a full magnolia
the same lawn 27 m south, 21 m from any wall: the lawn's second tree
the grass by the west houses, 4.5 m from the wall, nothing round it
the south-west corner of the block, 8.4 m from the walls: an old ficus at the corner
